findings.title: No database migration files; schema managed exclusively via EnsureCreatedAsync()
findings.resolution: Schema version cookie implemented via BackupService. CurrentSchemaVersion=1 constant at BackupService.cs:12. SaveBackupAsync stores db_backup + db_schema_version in localStorage. TryRestoreBackupAsync validates version, discards mismatches. Architectural decision for client-only SQLite — EnsureCreatedAsync remains per architecture.

findings.title: Missing foreign key relationships in entity configuration
findings.resolution: All FK relationships configured in OnModelCreating (ContestDbContext.cs:59-87). EntryScoreEntity uses composite PK (EntryId, CategoryId). Manual cascade delete code removed from repositories. No references to old surrogate EntryScoreEntity.Id remain.

findings.title: Database restore overwrites file with active DbContext connection
findings.resolution: Restore (Program.cs:32) happens before scope creation (Program.cs:34). No DbContext exists at restore time. Backup import delegated to DatabaseBackupService.ImportAsync with SQLite magic number validation.

findings.title: O(n*m) client-side join in SqliteEntryRepository queries
findings.reason: SqliteRepositories.cs:80-88 and 100-113 still perform categories.FirstOrDefault() per score in nested loops. FK relationships exist in OnModelCreating but EntryScoreEntity lacks Category navigation property (RA-EF-003), so .ThenInclude() is not possible.

findings.title: Missing .AsNoTracking() on all read-only repository queries
findings.reason: Zero .AsNoTracking() calls found in entire src/ directory. No changes from original audit.

findings.title: CalculateGlobalScoresAsync performs individual entry updates without transaction wrapping
findings.reason: ContestManager.cs:106-113 still calls UpdateAsync per entry in foreach loop. Each UpdateAsync calls SaveChangesAsync internally. No BeginTransactionAsync, no batched SaveChangesAsync.

findings.title: Connection string hardcoded in Program.cs rather than sourced from configuration
findings.reason: Program.cs:47: "Data Source=contest.db" hardcoded. No appsettings.json or environment variable usage.

findings.title: Missing indexes on frequently queried foreign key columns
findings.resolution: Indexes added: RelationEntity.CategoryId, RelationEntity.EntryAId, RelationEntity.EntryBId, EntryScoreEntity.EntryId. ContestDbContext.cs:89-92.

findings.title: No error handling around SaveChangesAsync calls in repository methods
findings.reason: All 8 SaveChangesAsync() calls (SqliteRepositories.cs:38,47,57,133,156,166,214,224) lack try/catch for DbUpdateException.

findings.title: EntryScoreEntity has redundant surrogate key alongside natural composite unique constraint
findings.resolution: Surrogate Id removed from EntryScoreEntity (ContestDbContext.cs:23-28). Composite PK (EntryId, CategoryId) at line 57. Zero references to old surrogate Id in all source files.

findings.title: DbContext class holds file I/O methods violating Single Responsibility Principle
findings.resolution: File I/O extracted to DatabaseBackupService.cs implementing IDatabaseBackupService. Import includes SQLite magic number validation. ContestDbContext no longer contains filesystem methods.

findings.title: No .IsRequired() or .HasMaxLength() configuration on string entity properties
findings.reason: No .IsRequired() or .HasMaxLength() calls in entire OnModelCreating. All string PK/FK columns use EF Core defaults.

findings.title: SQLite foreign key enforcement not enabled at database level
findings.rule_violated: SQLite best practice: always enable foreign key enforcement. Without it, the FK relationships configured in OnModelCreating have no physical constraint backing at the storage level.
findings.remediation: Change connection string to: 'Data Source=contest.db;foreign_keys=true'. Alternatively, execute PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON at connection open.

findings.title: Schema change cannot be applied to existing databases; EnsureCreatedAsync blocks migration
findings.rule_violated: Schema evolution must support existing databases. Changing PK types without migration breaks all existing installations.
findings.remediation: Option A: Use migrations (revisit EF-001 decision). Option B: Add DB file version marker; on mismatch, backup, delete, and recreate. Option C: Add startup check that detects old schema and offers migration or nuke-and-recreate with user confirmation.

findings.title: EntryScoreEntity lacks CLR navigation properties, blocking .ThenInclude() queries
findings.rule_violated: EF Core query efficiency: navigation properties on the entity model are required for .Include()/.ThenInclude() in LINQ queries. Shadow navigations from type-based FK config exist but are invisible to query expressions.
findings.remediation: Add 'public CategoryEntity Category { get; set; } = null!;' and 'public EntryEntity Entry { get; set; } = null!;' to EntryScoreEntity. Update FK config to use navigation: .HasOne(es => es.Category).WithMany(c => c.Scores).HasForeignKey(es => es.CategoryId). Then refactor repository queries to use .Include(e => e.Scores).ThenInclude(s => s.Category).
